description: This update focuses on strengthening the platform's core foundation, improving stability, and refining the overall user experience. It introduces a more reliable video player, official legal documentation, expanded localization support, a range of UI/UX enhancements, and a fully rebuilt Roadmap page designed to make YokaiVerse feel smoother, clearer, and more consistent.

logs.desc: The video player slider for greater precision and smoother seeking during both click and drag interactions.
'videoPlayerFeedback.ts', a new core engine module that streamlines interaction handling and feedback loops within the custom video player.
Official documentation pages, including '/doc', '/privacy', and '/terms', to improve transparency and make key project information easier to access.
Expanded Markdown support with custom elements and improved list rendering for a cleaner, more readable documentation experience.
A direct download option for the video player, improving accessibility and enabling offline viewing.
'LICENSE.md' under the AGPLv3 license, reinforcing the project's commitment to open-source, community-driven development.
Official localization support for Azerbaijani (AZ) and UK English.
Smart language detection so the site can automatically match the user's browser language when no preference has been set.
Interactive tooltips with full localization support.
Translation support for parts of the Info page, including the Overview and Banner chip sections.
'progressChip.astro', a reusable color-coded status chip component for roadmap items, supporting In Progress, Planned, Completed, Cancelled, and Considering states.
'changelogChip.astro', a reusable type chip component for changelog entries, covering 12 log types including Performance, Breaking, Security, Deprecated, and Reverted.
A fully configured Roadmap page with manifest-driven milestone loading, per-item status chips, and a dedicated hero section.
Roadmap milestone files for v0.4.0, v0.5.0, and v1.0.0, each with an ETA, overall milestone status, and a breakdown of planned items.
'manifest.json' for the roadmap versions directory, replacing sequential file crawling with an explicit and maintainable version list.
A 'categories' field to all root anime 'information.json' files, allowing each title to appear in one or more category listers on the Featured page.
The '/whats-new' route has been replaced by '/changelog'. Any existing bookmarks or external links pointing to the old URL will no longer work.
Text selection styling to improve contrast against the signature accent color.
'README.md' to better communicate the project's mission, setup details, and contributor guidelines.
The 'Latest Change' section so it dynamically pulls the most recent changelog configuration data.
The language switcher with a custom dropdown and integrated radio-button selection for a smoother localization experience.
'en_us' as the global fallback language to maintain a consistent experience when localization data is missing or unavailable.
Global Search with a full-screen overlay, preparing the foundation for upcoming universal search across Anime, Manga, and Settings.
The DOM to use a primary <div> wrapper instead of direct <body> manipulation, improving layout control and maintainability.
The 404 error page with a refreshed design and improved layout.
The loading overlay to provide smoother transitions and a more polished loading experience.
Brand assets and the primary accent color from #782DFA to #8478FD across both Light and Dark themes.
The Settings page with a cleaner interface and improved layout.
All changelog version descriptions and log entry text across v0.0.0 through v0.3.0 rewritten for improved clarity, grammar, and consistency.

Roadmap components ('versionTemplate', 'versionDetailTemplate', 'versionLogs', 'hero') overhauled from a changelog copy into a purpose-built roadmap layout with milestone-specific structure and status chip styling.
Changelog 'versionDetailTemplate.astro' and 'versionLogs.astro' refactored to use 'changelogChip', replacing raw color strings and innerHTML injection with the chip config pattern.
Log type assignments across all changelog versions corrected, with misclassified entries updated to use Performance, Breaking, and Deprecated types where appropriate.
Log entry order across all changelog versions now consistently sorted by priority: Performance, Added, Breaking, Changed, Fixed, Deprecated, Removed, Experimental, Known Bug, Misc.

'lister.astro' rewritten with a category-aware script that fetches 'animeIDs.json', groups titles by their categories array, and builds one independently paginated lister per category with working Previous and Next controls.
The Featured page container in 'companents.astro' updated with consistent gap and padding to match the rest of the page layout.
Pagination button IDs in 'lister.astro' corrected from the misleading 'nextPage'/'previousPage' to 'listerPrevPage'/'listerNextPage'.
An issue where episode lists could occasionally fail to load on the watch page.
A 'ListAnime.ts' bug that incorrectly displayed some age ratings as 'unknown'.
A critical issue where the loading overlay could remain visible after switching episodes, causing a soft lock.
Scrollbar styling to better match the site theme and improve visual consistency.
The 'ADDED MISC' label in the changelog renderer, now correctly displaying as 'Misc'.
Duplicate 'oshiNoKo' keys in 'animeIDs.json' that caused two of the three entries to be silently dropped by JSON parsers.
The 'Go To' navigation on the Changelog page has been temporarily disabled while the feature is being reworked.
Legacy Konami Code functionality to keep the codebase lean and focused.
